q-0374.answer: Scholars classify the 114 surahs by where they were first revealed: approximately **86 surahs are Meccan** (revealed before Hijrah in Makkah) and **28 are Medinan** (revealed after Hijrah in Madinah). Meccan surahs often focus on faith, tawhid, and the Hereafter; Medinan surahs often address law, community, and governance. Individual surah pages show each surah's revelation type.

q-0576.answer:
Surah Al-Ma'aarij (70) — The Ascending Stairways · 44 ayahs · Meccan

Main teachings:
• The believers believe that its occurrence is near, even though its time of occurrence is unknown and no one knows when it will be except Allah.
• Man is described with blameworthy characteristics except for He whom Allah protects, helps and guides to good, making its means easy for him – and these are those people who perform Salah.
• What is wrong with these disbelievers who are with you, O Muhammad? Why are they Muhti'in, meaning hastily running away from you?' This is as Al-Hasan Al-Basri said, "Muhti'in means departing.
• Be patient, O Muhammad, with your people's rejection and their seeking to hasten the torment since they think it will not occur.
• Whenever any harm touches him he is frightful, worried and completely taken back due to the severity of his terror and his despair that he will receive any good after it.

• He is the one who oppresses the orphan and does not give him his just due.
• The poor man who has nothing to sustain him and suffice his needs.

• And does not encourage the feeding of the poor.

q-0752.answer:
Surah Yunus (10) — Jonas · 109 ayahs · Meccan

Main teachings:
• If you find that it is too much of an offense that I should live among you and preach to you the revelation of Allah and His signs and proofs, then I do not care what you think, and I will not stop inviting you.
• We should worship Allah alone without partners while having different laws.
• Alif, Lam, Ra. These are the verses of the wise Book
• Have the people been amazed that We revealed [revelation] to a man from among them, [saying], "Warn mankind and give good tidings to those who believe that they will have a [firm] precedence of honor with their Lord"? [But] the disbelievers say, "Indeed, this is an obvious magician."
• Indeed, your Lord is Allah, who created the heavens and the earth in six days and then established Himself above the Throne, arranging the matter [of His creation]. There is no intercessor except after His permission. That is Allah, your Lord, so worship Him. Then will you not remember?

Quran 6:2 — Al-An'aam (The Cattle)
